<a id="vr-polar-bear-match-cut"></a>

## VR Match Cut From Polar Bear Battle to Living Room

[![Kling video preview of a woman fighting a polar bear before a VR match cut](<https://pbs.twimg.com/amplify_video_thumb/2039380425349419008/img/eKp1GTC6kgFTKxcx.jpg>)](<https://x.com/aimikoda/status/2039380650109649085>)

A survival fight freezes at impact before matching the same hand movement into a grounded VR reveal at home.

**Model:** Kling 3.0

```text
FORMAT: 15s / free rhythm / 1 MATCH CUT / CONTINUOUS MOVE UNTIL MATCH CUT + IMMEDIATE ACTION FROM FIRST FRAME

SUBJECTS: A lone sword-bearing woman in weathered fur and leather fights a massive polar bear with desperate, two-handed survival movement. The same woman is later revealed at home in loose indoor clothes, where a VR headset appears only after the match cut and is pulled off in one clear motion.
ENVIRONMENT: Frozen wilderness under hard daylight, wind dragging snow across blue-white ice, then a modest lived-in home reached through a precise visual match. Winter glare and visible breath give way to soft clutter, indoor daylight, and a faint game-lit glow.
MOOD: Visceral survival tension snaps into grounded reality without breaking physical continuity.
COLOR LOGIC: Naturalistic Film Print Emulation

TIMELINE:
0:00-0:07: One unbroken handheld move, WS collapsing into MCU as the woman backpedals across the ice and the bear launches through blowing snow. The camera runs beside the leap at eye level, 28mm shifting to 35mm, slightly unstable and close enough to keep both bodies heavy and readable. The bear closes fast while she plants, recoils, and keeps the blade between them. SFX: (howling wind, boots grinding ice, low animal roar, cloth strain, blade cutting air, snow scrape). Hard winter sun side-lights the ice and throws sharp blue shadows.
0:07-0:11: Same unbroken move, no cut, tightening into a dead-on CU as the bear surges into the last inches, claws near her shoulders, jaws filling the frame edge. Right in the middle of the attack, a man's voice calls, Karla... then sharper, KARLA. She answers with a tired off, and on that reaction the world drops into slow motion. Snow drifts almost still, the bear hangs in its strike, and only she keeps moving at normal speed as the camera orbits into her face. Bored, not afraid, she drops the sword and brings both empty hands toward her temples in one smooth interrupt gesture. No headset, visor, or device is visible in the frozen world. Stay continuous until the match cut, keeping the same face size, hand height, head angle, lens distance, and clockwise drift. SFX: (cloth strain building to near impact, a man's voice calling Karla... KARLA, her tired off, then stretched wind fading toward silence). Hard winter sun catches the slowed snow around her face.
0:11-0:15: MATCH CUT. CU to MS. Seamless mid-motion transition as her rising hands cross the same screen position and the frozen close-up becomes the home interior with the same framing and clockwise drift. The motion continues uninterrupted, and now a VR headset is visibly strapped over her eyes for the first time. She grips both sides, pulls it fully off her face, and the camera opens into a medium shot as she drops it above her forehead and steps into a small living room in loose home clothes. The handheld orbit continues, revealing couch edges, scattered blankets, and cold window light as her posture falls into mild annoyance. She turns toward the voice, rolls her eyes upward, and says, What is it. 35mm natural lens, spherical. SFX: (headset strap stretch, plastic rub, quiet room tone, socked foot scrape, faint game audio, her breath settling, her dry voice saying What is it). Indoor daylight replaces the winter contrast.
```

### How to adapt it

Keep the hand position, face scale, camera direction, and orbit aligned across the match cut. Replace both worlds and the interrupting action together.

**Source:** [Kōda](<https://x.com/aimikoda>)

[Original source](<https://x.com/aimikoda/status/2039380650109649085>) · [View in the KingVid gallery](<https://kingvid.app/kling-4-prompt#vr-polar-bear-match-cut>)

<a id="rural-explosion-time-freeze"></a>

## Rural Thriller Explosion Frozen in Time

[![Kling rural thriller explosion and pickup truck video preview](<https://pbs.twimg.com/amplify_video_thumb/2072258920278634496/img/H_pYOqSDRnGWNfK-.jpg>)](<https://x.com/techhalla/status/2072259228757049344>)

A 15-second survival scene moves from a live explosion into a frozen debris orbit, then resumes behind a pickup truck.

**Model:** Kling 3.0

```text
[STYLE + CAMERA + ATMOSPHERE]
Ultra-photorealistic cinematic 15-second action sequence from a grounded rural survival thriller film. Nighttime in a remote forested area next to a cabin. Pine trees, dirt ground, old pickup truck. Moonlight mixed with warm light from the cabin windows. The visual language is tense, intimate and realistic with hyper-realistic practical destruction. Camera is handheld-dynamic with grounded moves.

[IMAGE REFERENCES]
No reference images provided. Generate a fully consistent lead character: a rugged male in his early 50s, short beard, intense protective expression. He wears a worn jacket, jeans and work boots. Maintain exact same appearance and clothing throughout the clip.

[TIMELINE SECOND BY SECOND]
0-3s: [Dynamic handheld tracking shot from side-rear] The man runs toward an old pickup truck while being shot at. A propane tank next to the cabin explodes in a massive realistic blast. Fire, metal, wood and dirt are thrown violently in all directions. The camera tracks him urgently across the dirt as the explosion expands.

3-7s: [Slow continuous orbiting camera moving around the frozen explosion] At the peak of the explosion the entire blast and debris field suddenly freezes in perfect realistic physics. Thousands of metal fragments, wooden planks, dirt clods and burning debris hang motionless in the air with accurate weight and trajectories. The camera performs a smooth, continuous orbit around the frozen destruction, moving between large suspended metal pieces and passing close to sharp wooden fragments while the man remains visible.

7-15s: [Dynamic tracking shot as time resumes] At the 7-second mark time snaps back to forward motion with a slight realistic temporal residue. Some outer debris shows a very subtle reverse lag before continuing. The man has used the frozen moment to dive behind the pickup truck. When motion resumes, several large burning pieces miss the truck. He stays low and moves around the vehicle as debris finally crashes down around him. The camera tracks with him through the settling dust and fire.

[STYLE & QUALITY BOOSTERS]
Photorealistic 8K, hyper-realistic rigid body destruction with correct material properties, perfect frozen mid-air physics, seamless transition from explosion to freeze to resume, natural fire, wood and dirt interaction, heavy cinematic motion blur on fast debris, stable character performance, movie-level practical destruction VFX quality.
```

### How to adapt it

Preserve the three-phase rhythm—live action, frozen orbit, resumed escape—then replace the character, hazard, shelter, and debris materials.

**Source:** [TechHalla](<https://x.com/techhalla>)

[Original source](<https://x.com/techhalla/status/2072259228757049344>) · [View in the KingVid gallery](<https://kingvid.app/kling-4-prompt#rural-explosion-time-freeze>)

## Slow-Motion Flood Crowd Chaos

[![Kling slow-motion flood crowd video preview](<https://pbs.twimg.com/amplify_video_thumb/2078454191194869760/img/dupu9XmqO-VVWjl6.jpg>)](<https://x.com/gkxspace/status/2078454884861374485>)

A water-level handheld close-up layers crowd action, suspended spray, stable faces, and coarse 35mm texture around one subject.

**Model:** Kling 3.0

```text
Slow-motion handheld close-up, 16:9. Shaky organic handheld shot shoving in close on an older grey-haired man in a soaked white shirt and tie, chest-deep in churning green-grey flood water clutching a glass bottle, mouth open mid-shout — while all around him a dense crowd churns: a woman shoves past his shoulder, two men wrestle a floating chair behind him, someone falls backward into the water beside him sending up a slow sheet of spray, more panicking bodies wade and thrash in the background. In slow motion water explodes across the whole frame, droplets suspended everywhere. Dynamic jostling handheld movement at water level in the thick of the crowd. Sickly institutional palette — seafoam green, cream, muted teal, cold reflective water. All faces anatomically correct, stable, realistic, genuine emotion, no warping. Heavy coarse analog 35mm film grain baked into every frame, thick and consistent, grain crawling over highlights and shadows, like a scanned celluloid film print, never clean, never digital-looking. Flat overhead fluorescent light, dramatic slow-motion intensity, cinematic photorealistic, ultra-detailed.
```

### How to adapt it

Keep one foreground anchor, two or three readable background actions, and a unified material effect. Replace the crowd event, palette, and film stock treatment.

**Source:** [余温](<https://x.com/gkxspace>)

<a id="japanese-night-walk-dialogue-extend"></a>

## Japanese Night-Walk Dialogue With an Extension

[![Japanese Night-Walk Dialogue With an Extension video preview](<https://pbs.twimg.com/amplify_video_thumb/2104591885327355904/img/QX1O0x3SHd1j1jBS.jpg>)](<https://x.com/genel_ai/status/2104595625379823855>)

A Japanese POV night walk combines understated dialogue and handheld realism, with separate initial and continuation prompts.

**Model:** Kling 4.0

### Initial prompt · `ja`

```text
リアルな実写の日本のショートドラマ。男性目線のPOV映像。
日本の大学近くの夜の帰り道。20代前半の日本人女子大学生と男性大学生が、肩を並べて同じ方向へ歩いている。
男性本人は映らず、カメラそのものが男性の視点。男性は女性より少し背が高い。女性は男性のすぐ隣を歩き、カメラとの距離は近め。
30秒間すべてワンショット。
二人は最後まで横並びのまま歩き続ける。カメラは女性の真横の位置を維持し、前後へ回り込まない。ズーム、寄り引き、構図変更なし。
女性は基本的に前を見て歩き、男性に話しかけるときだけ自然に隣を見る。男性を見るときは、少し見上げるようにカメラレンズを見る。
スマートフォンで歩きながら撮影したようなリアルな質感。軽い手ブレ、自然な上下動、小さなピントの迷い、わずかな露出変化。映画的に作り込みすぎない。
BGMなし。足音、風、遠くの車など自然な夜の環境音のみ。
女性は失恋した直後だが、大げさに悲しまず、仲のいい男友達に愚痴っている自然なテンション。
0〜30秒
二人は横並びのまま夜道を歩いている。
女「三年付き合って、別れるの五分だったんだけど！」
言い終わるあたりで、女性が隣の男性を少し見上げる。
男「五分？」
女「うん。こっちは昨日、全然寝れなかったのに」
女性は自然に前を見る。
男「……ほぉ」
少し間を置いて、
女「しかも最後に言われたの、『袋いる？』だよ。スーパーかよ」
「スーパーかよ」は、少し呆れながら自分でも笑ってしまうような自然な言い方。
男「袋もらった？」
女性が「そこ聞く？」というような表情で男性を見る。
女「もらった」
男「もらったんだ」
女性が少し笑う。
女「だって荷物あったし」
言い終わったあと、二人で小さく笑う。
女性はまた前を向き、そのまま二人で歩き続ける。
字幕、テロップ、ロゴ、ウォーターマークなし。
男性の姿、腕、手は映さない。
女性は手に何も持たない。
セリフ以外の不自然な口パクなし。
```

### Extension prompt · `ja`

```text
前の映像からそのまま連続して始まる。30秒間ワンショット。男性と女性は最後まで完全に横並びで、同じ方向へ同じペースで歩き続ける。カメラの高さ、女性との距離、画角、位置関係は前半から変えない。男性は女性より少し背が高く、カメラは女性の真横からわずかに見下ろしている。女性の体は進行方向を向いたまま、男性を見るときだけ顔を向けて少し見上げるようにカメラレンズを見る。
女性が「だって荷物あったし」と言ったあとの小さな笑いが残っている。二人で少し笑い、そのまま数歩歩く。笑いが収まり、少し静かな空気になる。
女性は前を向いたまま、少し小さな声で、
女「……もっと何か言うと思ってた」
ぽろっと本音が出たような自然な言い方。
男「引き止めてほしかった？」
女性は少し考えながら前を向いたまま、
女「いや、別れるのは決めてたけど」
言い終わるあたりで少し男性を見る。
男「うん」
女性はまた前を見る。少し間を置いて、
女「……でも、なんかなぁ。なんかモヤるわぁ」
深刻に言いすぎず、自分でもうまく説明できない気持ちをそのまま話すような自然なトーン。
男「うむ」
女性は一瞬だけ男性を見て、少し「何その返事」という表情をするが何も言わず、また前を見る。
2〜3秒ほど会話が途切れる。足音、夜の風、遠くの車の音だけ。少し風が吹き、女性が肩をほんの少しすくめる。
女「なんか寒いな〜。 ひとりになったからかな〜？」
冗談っぽく、少し大げさに言う。「ひとりになったからかな〜？」と言いながら男性へ顔を向け、少し見上げるようにカメラレンズを見る。
男「あたためますか？」
男性は何でもないような自然な声で言う。ふざけた言い方にはしない。
このセリフは、前半の「袋いる？」→「スーパーかよ」という会話を男性が覚えていて、その流れを拾って女性を少し笑わせようとしているボケ。
女性はすぐには意図に気づかず、男性を見上げたまま一瞬だけ表情が止まる。約1秒〜1.5秒ほど間を置き、前半の「スーパーかよ」の流れを拾ったボケだと気づく。同時に、男性が自分の話をちゃんと聞いていて、重く慰めるのではなく笑わせようとしてくれていることにも自然に気づく。
その瞬間、女性の表情が少し柔らかくなる。大げさに感動せず、小さな嬉しさが表情ににじむ程度。
女「……コンビニかよ！」
怒ったツッコミではなく、「そこ拾ってくるんだ（笑）」という嬉しさと親しさが混じった言い方。最初の「……」はボケに気づくまでの一拍。「コンビニかよ！」と言うときには少し笑っている。
言い終わったあと、女性が少し下を向いて小さく笑う。男性もカメラの後ろから自然に少し笑う。女性はもう一度だけ男性をちらっと見上げ、少し嬉しそうな笑顔を残したまま前を向く。
「……コンビニかよ！」以降、新しいセリフは追加しない。そのまま二人で横並びに歩き続け、足音と夜の環境音だけを残して終了する。
演技は全体的に大げさにしない。「温めますか？」を恋愛的な意味に受け取る演技にはしない。すぐには意味が分からない → 前半のボケを拾ったことに気づく → 自分を笑わせようとしてくれた優しさにも気づく → 少し嬉しくなる → 「……コンビニかよ！」と笑って返す、という小さな感情変化で見せる。
恋愛感情を明確に出しすぎず、「この人、ちゃんと話聞いてくれてたんだ」「この人といると少し楽になるな」くらいの感情に留める。
カメラは最後まで女性の真横。女性が男性より前へ出ない。男性が女性より後ろへ下がらない。女性の正面へ回り込まない。振り返っているような構図にしない。カットなし、ズームなし、寄り引きなし、構図変更なし、カメラ位置変更なし。BGMなし。字幕、テロップ、ロゴ、ウォーターマーク、画面内文字なし。
```

### How to adapt it

Keep the camera relationship, walking pace, and ambience fixed. Extend the conversation by recalling an earlier joke and preserving its emotional tone.

```text
20s, 16:9, 6 cuts, photoreal live-action, native audio with synced dialogue, British English accents. No on-screen text, subtitles, captions, watermarks or logos.

STYLE: intimate chamber drama, 35mm grain, shallow focus, understated performances.

CAST: NORA - woman, 45, auburn hair in a loose knot, black reading glasses pushed up on top of her head, grey cardigan over a faded T-shirt, tired eyes. ELLIE - her younger sister, 32, black curly shoulder-length hair soaked from rain, oversized denim jacket, jeans, silver hoop earrings.

PROPS: two identical mustard mugs. Nora holds one. A second, empty mug stands clearly visible at the empty chair opposite her.

PALETTE: amber pendant lamp vs cold teal under-cabinet light, deep shadows, natural skin.
STORY: At 3 a.m. Ellie comes home to admit she sold their late mother's house. Nora already knows.

BEATS:
0.0-3.5s | CUT 1, wide, static, eye level: heavy rain on the kitchen window. Ellie stands frozen in the doorway on the left, dripping. Nora sits at the table on the right, hands round her mug; the empty mug waits opposite. Stillness.

3.5-7.5s | CUT 2, clean medium close-up on Nora, nothing in the foreground, 50mm, slow push-in. Eyes down. NORA (flat, quiet, exhausted): "You sold it. Mum's house. Without asking me."

7.5-12.0s | CUT 3, close-up on Ellie in the doorway, 85mm, subtle handheld. Her eyes fill with tears; she swallows before speaking. ELLIE (defensive, voice cracking on the last word): "I was drowning, Nora. You weren't answering."

12.0-15.5s | CUT 4, same clean medium close-up on Nora, eyes dry at first. She looks up, pulls the glasses down off her head and sets them on the table. Only then does one tear run down her cheek. She says nothing. Only rain.

15.5-18.0s | CUT 5, low profile shot along the tabletop: Nora's hand slides the empty second mug across the wood to the empty chair. NORA (whisper, barely voiced): "Sit down."

18.0-20.0s | CUT 6, medium close-up on Ellie, already seated at the table, both hands round the second mug. One shaky breath, half laugh, half sob, then stillness. Hold.

AUDIO: dialogue close and dry. Steady rain on glass audible from the first frame, fridge hum, room tone. Mug scrape on wood at 16s. Ellie's half-laugh sob at 18.5s. No music.

NEGATIVE: no text, no extra people, no foreground shoulders in Nora's shots, no repeat of the CUT 1 wide, no props appearing or vanishing, no melodramatic sobbing, no face morphing, no lip-sync drift.
```

### How to adapt it

Define cast and prop continuity first, then give each timed shot one emotional beat. Treat silence and small object movements as part of the story.

## Into the Infinite Sky: Cinematic Cloud Flight

[![Into the Infinite Sky: Cinematic Cloud Flight video preview](<https://pbs.twimg.com/amplify_video_thumb/2105063462594543616/img/CadRYb4bW0DJ7mbc.jpg>)](<https://x.com/bmx_ai13/status/2105168764681453666>)

An athletic man leaps from a floating cliff into a vast cloud world, guided by four timed shots and a detailed continuity prompt.

**Model:** Kling 4.0 Flash

```text
CRITICAL: Perfect character continuity across every shot. One lone athletic man, bare-chested, simple dark charcoal athletic shorts, barefoot, short dark hair, lean defined build, same body and hair in every frame. No wings, no superhero suit, no costume, no visible technology. Anatomy stays correct at all times: two arms, two legs, no extra limbs, no warped or floating body parts, no sudden pose changes.

SUBJECT LOCK: The man is 30s, athletic, natural muscle definition, tanned skin with visible pores and subtle sweat sheen. Dark charcoal shorts only. Hair and shorts react naturally to wind in every shot.

WORLD PLATE: A tiny grassy cliff floats impossibly high above an endless ocean of dense volumetric silver-white clouds thousands of meters below. Gigantic pale twisted cable-like structures stretch across the cloudscape and vanish into infinity. A colossal luminous planetary ring system crosses the sky diagonally, filled with countless bright parallel streaks catching sunlight. Massive distant floating rock formations sit partially silhouetted in the sky. Clear blue upper atmosphere, brilliant sunlight, realistic aerial haze, strong atmospheric perspective. The structures feel physically present and real, never abstract or psychedelic.

PALETTE: Cool blue sky, soft silver-white clouds, muted natural green grass, dark charcoal shorts, bright white ring highlights. Realistic sunlight with deep shadows and true highlights. Slight dreamy softness while textures stay sharp and photoreal.

SHOT 1 (0-3s): Wide cinematic rear shot, low angle. The man stands at the edge of the grassy plateau facing the impossible cloud world, his long shadow stretching behind him. After a brief still moment he bursts into a run toward the cliff edge. The camera tracks smoothly behind and low to the grass, building speed with him. Accurate foot contact, real momentum and body weight, grass blades bending under each step. Giant celestial structures dominate the background.

SHOT 2 (3-5s): He reaches the edge and launches forward into empty space. The camera follows the leap as the ground vanishes beneath him. It begins as a real human dive, arms extending naturally, then eases into a smooth horizontal glide. Reveal the enormous vertical depth of the clouds below him.

SHOT 3 (5-9s): Cut to a dramatic fast side-profile tracking close shot. He flies rapidly just above the cloud tops. Wind pushes across his body and hair, muscles subtly reacting to the airflow. One colossal twisted structure passes overhead, emphasizing scale and speed. Clouds streak beneath him with strong parallax, sunlight flashing across his skin, realistic motion blur.

SHOT 4 (9-15s): Epic rear pursuit shot, centered composition. The camera follows directly behind him as he flies deeper into the surreal world. Two gigantic twisted pathways stretch forward on either side of him. Far ahead the luminous rings rise across the entire sky while a huge dark floating rock formation hangs overhead. Slowly pull the camera wider as he becomes smaller against the vast scale. Final beat: he continues toward the brilliant horizon, arms slightly open, surrounded by clouds and celestial architecture.

CAMERA: Smooth cinematic tracking only, no handheld shake. Grounded low-angle tracking, then wide aerial perspective, then fast side-profile tracking, then centered rear chase. Strong foreground-to-background parallax.

MOTION: Flight is smooth and aerodynamic, controlled and human, never stiff or superhero-like. Hair, clouds and atmospheric particles react naturally to strong high-altitude wind.

SOUND BED: Diegetic and atmospheric only, no dialogue. Quiet high-altitude wind and distant ambience at open. Footsteps accelerate across grass. A powerful wind rush hits at the leap. During flight build layered deep air movement, subtle cinematic bass and expansive melodic progressive-trance energy. Close on an uplifting atmospheric swell as he disappears into the infinite landscape.

LAST FRAME: The man small in the center of the frame flying toward the bright horizon, arms slightly open, clouds and twisted structures on both sides, luminous rings above. No on-screen text, no subtitles, no logos, no watermarks, no UI elements, no branding of any kind.
```

### How to adapt it

Separate subject locks, world design, timed action, camera movement, and audio. Keep wardrobe and anatomy constraints consistent as scale and speed increase.

## Janitor Bank Fight With a Deadpan Ending

[![Janitor Bank Fight With a Deadpan Ending video preview](<https://pbs.twimg.com/amplify_video_thumb/2104974061969584129/img/aaY75IFmCxQ7tGSf.jpg>)](<https://x.com/MayorKingAI/status/2104974096513872227>)

A 20-second text-to-video action comedy moves from a bank robbery to a mop-led fight and a quiet cleanup punchline.

**Model:** Kling 4.0 Flash

```text
High-octane cinematic action-comedy, gritty realistic thriller look, teal & orange grade,
subtle film grain, fast-paced editing.
Interior of a modern bank, polished marble and glass, cold fluorescent + window light.
Terrified hostages kneeling with hands behind their heads, heads bowed against the wall.

Shot 1 (0-4s): wide handheld shot, tense. Three masked robbers wave guns and shove people.
Robber 1 (shouting): "Nobody moves! Fill the bag, now!"
Robber 2 (kicking a chair): "Down! Stay down!"

Shot 2 (4-8s): slow dolly-in on a thin old Chinese janitor calmly mopping, unbothered.
He mutters: "So much noise for a Tuesday." His eyes narrow — calculation.
He flicks the wet mop; water splashes across a robber's visor.

Shot 3 (8-9s): whip-pan. Robber 3 spins: "Sit down, gramp—"
The mop handle cracks across his jaw mid-word. Impact freeze, bass hit.

Shot 4 (9-16s): explosive continuous martial-arts sequence, escalating. He vaults over
the counter, disarms Robber 1 with a spinning mop strike, sends the gun sliding across
marble. Hand-to-hand blur: elbow, sweep, a robber crashes through a glass partition
in slow-motion shards. He kicks a rolling office chair into the third, springboards off
the desk, and takes him down in a fast combo. Orbiting dynamic camera, quick cuts,
snap-zooms, brief slow-mo on each impact, debris and papers flying.

Shot 5 (16-18s): the three robbers groaning, sprawled among broken glass and scattered cash.
Wide low-angle hero shot, the janitor standing calm, mop over his shoulder.

Shot 6 (18-20s): he wrings out the mop and resumes cleaning.
Old man (deadpan): "Now I have to mop again." Static medium shot. Camera settles.

Lighting: cold realistic base, rim light on the janitor during the fight, hard shadows,
sparks and dust catching the light.
Audio: fearful murmurs, tense silence before the first hit, bone-crunch impacts, whooshes,
glass shatter, driving percussive music surging through the fight.
Constraints: no watermark, no on-screen text, no logos, keep the janitor's face and
outfit consistent across shots.
```

### How to adapt it

Build the escalation around one recognizable prop, assign each shot a clear action, and reserve the final seconds for a calm payoff.
